:::{#exm-ident}
#### Identically distributed but not independent

In @exm-indpt, $X_1$ and $1 - X_1$ (the indicator of tails on the first flip)
both take the values $0$ and $1$ with probability $1/2$ each,
so they are identically distributed (@thm-ident-pmf).
They are not independent: knowing one determines the other.

:::
